_readme: Where the agent is allowed to write. Data, not code: edit and restart.
sandbox.py loads this next to itself, the way ui.py loads ui.json.
THE FENCE
enabled  master switch. NANOCODE_SANDBOX=0 turns the fence off for a run.
The fence only applies in ACT mode - PLAN mode has no write tools.
roots    folders writes are allowed in. Relative paths resolve against the
directory the agent was started in, so ["."] means 'just in the
folder'. Add more to widen it, e.g. ["..", "C:\\tmp\\scratch"].
NANOCODE_SANDBOX_ROOTS overrides this (os.pathsep-separated,
so ';' on Windows: ".;C:\\tmp\\scratch").
deny     subtrees refused even when they sit inside a root. Deny beats
root - good for .git, .env, credentials, build droppings.
WHAT A REFUSAL DOES
writes nothing, returns an 'Error: FORBIDDEN ...' string to the model,
prints a red FORBIDDEN line, and plays the sandbox_denied alarm from
sounds.json (that alarm is not silenced by NANOCODE_SOUND=off: it is an
alarm, not decoration. NANOCODE_SOUND_ALARM=0 does silence it).
LIMITS
The file tools (write_file, edit_file, write_plan) are fenced strictly.
run_command only gets a best-effort check of redirects and obvious
mutators (rm, cp, mv, mkdir ...). A shell can do anything a shell can do.
